harness.discipline: own scripts; TZ=UTC with date at 12:00 UTC and Intl zone rendering; no clock read; Rounding.None then explicit floor/ceil/nearest; raw captures read from disk; no network

claims.subject: Pakistan federal Nizam-e-Salat chart
claims.claim: Karachi 18/18 Hanafi angles + two-phase dhuhr clock (13:00/13:15, switching 15 Apr/15 Oct) + a 19-step quarter-hour isha ladder

headline.column_mapping: c1 fajr adhan, c2 fajr jamaat, c3 sunrise, c4 dhuhr adhan, c5 dhuhr jamaat, c6 asr adhan, c7 asr jamaat, c8 sunset, c9 maghrib adhan, c10 isha adhan, c11 isha jamaat; mapping re-derived from solar geometry and jamaat deltas (-0.87 min sunrise, +0.95 sunset, +5.95 maghrib, jamaat +15)
headline.dhuhr_switch_source: read from the printed April and October rows at 3x render

claims.notes: The 19-step claim is exact as 19 switch dates; the ladder prints 11 distinct values. The sheet carries a twelfth cell under maghrib jamaat that prints a weekday note, not a time.

claims.subject: Muhammadiyah KHGT Indonesia
claims.claim: 18/18 + 1 minute, holding 2025-2035, 7.8 minutes after Kemenag every year

headline.within1: 62/62 in each of 18 city-year cells; 0 worse than 1 min
headline.feasible_margin: about 0.92 to 1.08 per city-year; decade intersection empty by 0.033 min (2 s)

claims.notes: The decade and the 1-minute tolerance hold. The headline 7.8 min is low by 0.1 to 0.7 min depending on the city; the constant-gap finding stands.

claims.subject: Tunisia INM

headline.recipe: fajr 18.1 round, isha 18.1 round, dhuhr transit +7 round, maghrib sunset +2 ceil, asr Shafi 0 nearest
headline.free_fit_per_year: fajr 18.09-18.10, isha 18.10, dhuhr +7 round or +6.5 ceil, maghrib +2 ceil or +2.5 round, asr nearest 0

claims.notes: Reproducibility defect: deep2/tn-deep.json records asr as floor 0, which gives 2091/2557 (81.8%) joint, not the 94.2% headline. Nearest 0 reproduces 94.21%.

claims.subject: Algeria ministry calendar
claims.claim: Algeria is frozen 1447->1448 and 1448 is recomputed, not reprinted

headline.calibration: Rajab 1448, PDF page 8, 29 rows transcribed independently; 174 cells match fit2's transcription exactly
headline.transfer: the Rajab-only recipe is within 1 on every column of all seven other months (208 days)
headline.frozen_constants: 1447 and 1448 joint fits return the same constants
headline.published_pair_also_holds: 17.80 floor 0 and 16.10 nearest +5: 237/237 within 1 on all six columns

claims.notes: The specific constants are not identifiable to 0.1 degree from minute-printed data: 17.4/-2 and 17.8/0, 15.73/+7.5 and 16.1/+5, are equivalent families. The printed times, and therefore the frozen verdict, are identifiable.

claims.subject: England town tables
claims.claim: England's towns are interval tables in the LUPT construction, not angle tables
claims.counterexample: Nottingham Islamic Centre 2026: Karachi 18/18 reproduces fajr 220/273 exact and 244/273 within 1 (worst 4) on its 273 defect-free rows; F swings 114 to 243 min across the year. Watford November: 18/18 30/30 within 1, 29/30 exact, F 111-119. Oxford 2026: 18/18 332/365 within 1.

nottingham_2026.18_18: 220/273 exact, 244/273 within 1, worst 4 on 273 defect-free rows; 332/365 within 1 over all rows

scan_of_18_surfaces.caveat: one-month surfaces cannot separate a 15-degree angle from a table; the three angle surfaces are decisive, the exact table count is soft

claims.notes: The modal English form is the LUPT interval construction (Luton's F and I arrays are nearly cell-identical to ELM/LUPT); the unqualified 'not angle tables' is false. The night's own fit12 records the same Karachi trio.
